items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: I mean that’s a good leader. And that’s why Martin was so great because he just rose up through becoming a theologian to become who he was.

ctx.x: And they have their own agenda for themselves.

Yeah. I mean that’s a good leader. And that’s why Martin was so great because he just rose up through becoming a theologian to become who he was. I mean here’s a man who made his father change his name because he became a great man. He became Martin Luther. He wasn’t born Martin Luther, he was Melvin Lewis. And because he was a junior dad had to change his name too.
